# EcclesiaOS v1.0.46

## Release summary

EcclesiaOS v1.0.46 adds a protected Backup & Disaster Recovery Center and hardens church communication email delivery with real SMTP provider testing.

## Added

- Added encrypted full, database, and files backup packages with background processing and progress tracking.
- Added backup history, downloads, integrity verification, resumable restore uploads, isolated restore validation, and production restore authorization safeguards.
- Added local, S3-compatible, and SFTP backup destinations with off-site health checks.
- Added automated backup schedules, retention policies, and scheduled backup execution.
- Added the Backup & Disaster Recovery administration workspace with dashboard, backup, restore, destination, and automation views.

## Fixed

- Email provider SMTP settings now drive the actual mail transport instead of relying only on global environment mail settings.
- Email provider connection tests now send a real test message and record the delivery result.
- SMTP configuration validation now checks the host, port, username, password, and sender email.
- Email delivery errors are surfaced in provider diagnostics and delivery logs.

## Database and deployment

- Adds the backup and disaster-recovery tables migration.
- The standard EcclesiaOS updater runs the migration automatically with no manual database work required.
- SMTP passwords remain encrypted in provider settings and are never stored in release files.

## Verification

- PHP syntax validation passed for the communication controller and delivery dispatcher.
- Blade view compilation passed.
- Production Vite build passed.
- Live SMTP testing reached Gmail successfully; the supplied credential was rejected by Gmail with `535 Username and Password not accepted` and must be replaced with a valid Gmail App Password.
